row.notes: New row. Tessian was acquired by Proofpoint; tessian.com redirects to proofpoint.com/us/tessian-is-now-proofpoint and the products are now sold as Proofpoint Core Email Protection API and Adaptive Email DLP. No public pricing: Proofpoint prices by user licences and contract term through the account team. The product deploys through Microsoft 365 APIs and reads Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Okta activity via API integrations (protected-user coverage, not admin provisioning). The old Tessian help centre (help.tessian.com, docs.tessian.com) no longer resolves and Proofpoint product docs are not public, so SCIM or admin-portal SSO could not be checked. Not in the Okta OIN, Entra gallery toc or JumpCloud catalogue.
